name: nexus
description: All-in-one workspace suite: HUD and session monitor, prompt enhancer, assumption review, command shield, secret masking, turn checkpoints with rollback, visual design previews, auto-verify and clean delivery.

shield.title: Command Shield
shield.description: Ask before dangerous shell commands run (recursive deletes, force pushes, dropped tables, pushes to protected branches).

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branch names the shield guards against pushes.

sanitizer.title: Secret Leak Sanitizer
sanitizer.description: Mask API keys, tokens, passwords and private keys in every row before it is stored or sent to the model.

checkpoints.title: Turn checkpoints
checkpoints.description: Snapshot the project into a private shadow git repo before the first file change of each turn, so /rollback-nexus can undo the turn.

assumptionAudit.title: Assumption review
assumptionAudit.description: plan: review assumptions when a plan is presented. first-edit: also before the first file edit of each turn. off: never.

autoVerify.title: Auto lint/test
autoVerify.description: After a turn that changed files, run the project's linters and tests and send failures back to Claude to fix.

maxHealAttempts.title: Self-heal attempts
maxHealAttempts.description: How many times a failing check is sent back to Claude before giving up.

verifyTimeoutSec.title: Check timeout (seconds)
verifyTimeoutSec.description: Longest a single lint or test command may run.

quietTranscript.title: Quiet transcript
quietTranscript.description: Draw routine tool calls as one dim line and hide their raw output (errors and file edits stay visible).

executiveSummary.title: Executive summary
executiveSummary.description: Ask Claude to skip progress chatter and end each change with What Changed / Verification Status / Next Steps.

designLens.title: Design Lens
designLens.description: Give Claude a tool that shows UI options as live visual cards in the browser and a pane, and sends your pick back.

devServerUrl.title: Dev server URL
devServerUrl.description: URL /preview-nexus captures. Empty: probe common localhost ports.

helperModel.title: Helper model
helperModel.description: Model used for prompt enhancement and assumption extraction.

notify.title: Done / approval alerts
notify.description: A desktop notification and a sound when a long turn finishes, and a sound when Claude needs your approval.

notifyAfterSec.title: Alert after (seconds)
notifyAfterSec.description: Only turns that ran at least this long raise the done alert.

compactGuard.title: Compaction guard
compactGuard.description: Warn at 80% context, and tell compaction to keep file paths, open tasks, check results and decisions.

handoff.title: Session handoff
handoff.description: Save a short summary when a session ends and show it when the next session in the project starts (/handoff-nexus).

loopGuard.title: Loop detector
loopGuard.description: When Claude repeats the same failing call, tell it to stop and change approach; warn when a turn runs very long.

maxAgents.title: Max subagents at once
maxAgents.description: Refuse new subagents past this many running at once. 0: no limit.

suggestNext.title: Next-step suggestion
suggestNext.description: After a reply, offer its first Next Step as the prompt's dim suggestion (Tab takes it).

commitHelper.title: Commit helper
commitHelper.description: After a turn that changed files, offer a Commit button and /commit-nexus with a drafted message.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Colors, bars and icons of the HUD and drawers. /skin-nexus switches it on the fly (the pick is remembered across sessions).
